quotations.old_english: Ic secge hér beforan eów eallum folcsðð
quotations.english: I say here before you all the plain and simple truth

source_text: folc-sóp the plain truth (?) :-- Ic secge hér beforan eów eallum folcsðð I say here before you all the plain and simple truth, Hml, S. 23, 666. Cf. folc-wóh.
